_comment: Help desk capability comparison shown on the Features & roadmap page. Written once, offline. The GLPI and Zammad columns come from round 3 of the competitor reading in the private repo concurrentie-analyse (procest/_round3/compare/ plus procest/glpi/round3/M1-column.md and procest/zammad/round3/M1-column.md), where both products were installed and driven locally on 2026-09-09 and every cell carries a file-and-line citation. Every row here names the question it came from in `source`, so a rival cell can be traced back to the reading that produced it. The pipelinq column was read from this repository at the revision in `pipelinqRevision`. Rows are reworded for a help desk audience; the QUESTION each row asks is unchanged, which is what makes the rival ratings still true. NEVER re-rate a rival here without installing that product again: set `addedOn` on the row and leave the rival cells `unknown` instead. Eight candidate rows were parked because all three systems answered `no` to them, and a row nobody passes measures a specification rather than a product: file versions with restore, office editing in the browser, ticket files in the platform file manager, search from the platform search bar, widgets driven by a saved view, an export area with expiry and download counts, a message broker, and an access list on a single ticket. Put one back the day a system in this table answers it.
